title: Information-Induced Training Geometry: Exact Reduction, Canonical Completion, and Structured Expressivity
summary: Training data constrains optimizer geometry through the covectors visible to a declared information channel. We study how such partial information determines a full positive cometric relative to a reference and which degrees of freedom remain unidentified. Our central result resolves full-column-rank positive-definite compression under affine-invariant Riemannian geometry.
